task.question: At what age did veteran anime voice actor Takaya Hashi, known for Kakuzu in Naruto and Donovan Desmond in Spy × Family, die on 27 August 2025?
task.evidence: Hashi died from a heart attack on 27 August 2025, at the age of 72.

answer:
Takaya Hashi was born on September 8, 1952, and died on August 27, 2025. To find his age at the time of death, I will calculate the difference between these dates.

Takaya Hashi was 72 years old when he passed away. 

FINAL: 72

At what age did veteran anime voice actor Takaya Hashi, known for Kakuzu in Naruto and Donovan Desmond in Spy × Family, die on 27 August 2025?

[Takaya Hashi] Takaya Katō (加藤 孝也, Katō Takaya; 8 September 1952 – 27 August 2025), known professionally as Takaya Hashi (土師 孝也, Hashi Takaya), was a Japanese voice actor. He voiced Toki in Fist of the North Star, Kakuzu in Naruto, Vearn in Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai, and Donovan Desmond in Spy × Family. He was a representative director at the talent agency Apte Pro until his death.
